context.terminalOutput: parent-verified -opost in proved private PTY for owned suites; previous mode restored before stock collection
context.pixels: nonce-bound owned offscreen renders; fixed synthetic phases, retained PNGs and render context; no live desktop timing
context.cells: private observe-only AgentHost; nonce-bound pane; separate ASCII cell-state suite
context.attributes: separate ASCII SGR flags and palette-index suite
context.cellDetails: separate stored ARGB/underline and rendition/charset suites; no theme resolution or pixels
context.cursorModes: stored cursor style/blink/default/visibility; pristine owned DECSTR cleanup, no host appearance or blink phase

historyReport.scope: Owned ASCII history accumulation, SU/SD/RI, margins and origin-relative homing. Complete viewport cells and actual bounded ordered history text, with before/after state and exact restoration. Invalid-region cases qualify margins only with a cursor already home. No resize/reflow, history attribute, Unicode editing, pixel or stock-grade claim.
